stem.text: A metal wire is stretched to breaking point and the force-extension graph is plotted.
Which graph is correctly labelled with the elastic region, the plastic region and the area representing the work done to stretch the wire until it breaks?

A.alt: Force against extension graph: a straight line rising from the origin, then a curve levelling off, with labels elastic region, plastic region and work done, a dashed vertical line, and a shaded area under the left part of the curve.

B.alt: Force against extension graph: a curve rising from the origin and flattening, with labels plastic region, elastic region and work done, and a shaded area under the whole curve.

C.alt: Force against extension graph: a straight line rising from the origin, a dashed vertical line, then a curve levelling off, with labels elastic region, plastic region and work done, and a shaded area to the right of the dashed line.

D.alt: Force against extension graph: a curve rising from the origin and flattening, with labels elastic region, plastic region and work done, and a shaded area under the whole curve.
